question: Priya covers a certain distance by her car at a speed of 21 km/h and returns at a speed of 17 km/h. What is her average speed during the travel?
solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

When equal distances are covered at speeds a and b, the average speed is given by (2 × a × b) ÷ (a + b).

⇒ Average Speed = (2 × 21 × 17) ÷ (21 + 17)

⇒ Average Speed = 714 ÷ 38

⇒ Average Speed = 357 ÷ 19

⇒ Average Speed = 18¹⁵/₁₉ km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 18¹⁵/₁₉ km/h.**
